description: This file defines classes and functions for managing browser targets, contexts, downloads, and related events in a Firefox environment, including handling of permissions, cookies, video recording, and dialogs, as part of a Mozilla project related to Playwright integration.

classes.name: DownloadInterceptor
classes.description: Handles download request interception, creation, completion, and cancellation within the browser context.

classes.name: TargetRegistry
classes.description: Manages browser targets, contexts, and events, including page creation, navigation, and download handling.

classes.name: PageTarget
classes.description: Represents a page target, managing its lifecycle, settings, dialogs, video recording, and screencast functionalities.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context, managing permissions, cookies, proxies, and page instances.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a modal dialog in the browser, supporting creation, acceptance, and dismissal.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TargetRegistry.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TargetRegistry, setting up observers, event listeners, and download interception.

methods.name: shouldBustHTTPAuthCacheForProxy
methods.description: Determines if the HTTP auth cache should be cleared for a given proxy.

methods.name: _updateProxiesWithSameAuthCacheAndDifferentCredentials
methods.description: Updates the set of proxies with conflicting authentication credentials.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by UUID.

methods.name: getProxyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves proxy information for a given network channel.

methods.name: browserContextForId
methods.description: Retrieves a browser context by its ID.

methods.name: browserContextForUserContextId
methods.description: Retrieves a browser context by its user context ID.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page within a specified browser context.

methods.name: _newPageInternal
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a new page and open a new window.

methods.name: targetForBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves a target associated with a specific browser.

methods.name: targetForBrowserId
methods.description: Retrieves a target by browser ID.
